name: Sun Urban Park
usps: Seamlessly blends residential with ground, first, and second-floor retail development.
Earthquake Resistant RCC Framed Structure equipped with a hydro-pneumatic water supply system.
Well-equipped Fire Hydrant System and Rooftop Solar System to power common areas.
Features a Grey Water Treatment Plant and energy-conservative LED fixtures.
amenities: Swimming pool, pool deck, and indoor gymnasium.
Multipurpose synthetic turf, play park, and event lawn.
Indoor games, reading room, and fountain plaza.
2 Automatic Elevators per block with 1.5 meter per second speed.
